title: CQ: correct N1 day-view coverage and evidence/reviewer packet mistakes
public_pr_body:
Re-read the 11 changed files in #281–#284 once against the immediate real source/manual/money files. Found N1 omitted the Hours/day view required by G04.2: it now also checks planned daily totals, the actual daily Paid tile/reload and paid/unpaid explanation, retaining weekly/two-company assertions.

Corrects full browser proof paths and stale backend next-action wording in the go/no-go register. Corrects twelve misleading reviewer-check paragraphs produced by earlier keyword grouping (CI/packet/runbook/handover PRs had wipe-only directions), and refreshes #281–#284 source heads and actual CI conclusions. Preserves the historical 148-packet inventory; no new broad inventory/audit. CL arithmetic tests/fixtures and protected costing engine/rates/60 answers are unchanged.

Exact CQ head: bcf29b1589dfe9a15a593c583984e6c457690b1d. Source heads and findings are in tests/CQ-REVIEW-281-284.md. Checks: changed N1 ESLint and npx tsc --noEmit pass; three acceptance specs collect. Runtime command REVIEWER_REQUIRE_DATABASE=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/acceptance FAILS in setup with TEST_SUPABASE_URL unset; no browser assertion or SQL ran. 22 N2/N3 rows/30 exact proof titles and all 148 packet fields checked. Local reconstructed-source/shared-dependency limits remain explicit.

CQ targets #284 and leaves original #281–#284 branches unchanged for review. No app logic, main merge, production SQL, Ready label, full suite or broad audit. NO GO and untested runtime conditions remain.

- [x] One read, concrete corrections, type/lint/collection and mapping checks
- [ ] Actual disposable-backend browser/parity evidence and independent review
